title: mysearch
summary: DEFAULT search skill for OpenClaw. Aggregates Tavily, Firecrawl, Exa, and optional X/social search behind one search path. Use for ANY external lookup that needs current web results, docs, GitHub, changelog, pricing, URL extraction, or X discussion. Prefer this over legacy Tavily-only skill or raw web_search when MySearch is healthy.
